rationale: Inverted-checkerboard pair: globally identical luminance / contrast / mean, but pixel-wise wildly different. A buggy SSIM that drops the structure term (Wang 2004 Eq. 13's third factor) or compares only means would score this pair as ~1.0 (false positive). The correct skimage structural_similarity scores it ~0.04 (large structural divergence). The meta-test asserts SSIM < 0.5 — well outside any plausible identity-pair score.
